description: Deploy or roll back one validated Food Rescue commit from origin/main.

ExpectedSha.description: Full commit SHA selected by the reviewed GitHub Actions workflow.

ExpectedMainSha.description: Exact origin/main SHA whose tooling passed the workflow checks.

DeployMode.description: Deploy current main or roll back to an ancestor of main.

AppUser.description: Unprivileged owner of the repository and virtual environment.

AppDir.description: Absolute application directory on the managed instance.

runCommand: [[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]] || { echo 'SSM command must run as root.' >&2; exit 20; }
[[ -z "$(git_as_app status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]] || { echo 'EC2 working tree is not clean.' >&2; exit 21; }
[[ "$origin_main" == "$SSM_ExpectedMainSha" ]] || { echo 'origin/main changed after workflow validation.' >&2; exit 22; }

if [[ "$SSM_DeployMode" == 'deploy' ]]; then [[ "$SSM_ExpectedSha" == "$origin_main" ]] || { echo 'Expected SHA does not match origin/main.' >&2; exit 22; }; else git_as_app merge-base --is-ancestor "$SSM_ExpectedSha" "$origin_main" || { echo 'Rollback target is not in origin/main history.' >&2; exit 23; }; fi
EXPECTED_SHA="$SSM_ExpectedSha" EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA="$SSM_ExpectedMainSha" DEPLOY_MODE="$SSM_DeployMode" APP_DIR="$SSM_AppDir" APP_USER="$SSM_AppUser" bash "$deployment_script"
